mn126:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
mn126:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Bhūmijo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Jayasenassa rājakumārassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn126:3.1: Atha kho Jayaseno rājakumāro yen' āyasmā Bhūmijo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmatā Bhūmijena saddhiṃ sammodi
mn126:3.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Jayaseno rājakumāro āyasmantaṃ Bhūmijaṃ etad avoca:--
mn126:3.3: Santi, bho Bhūmija, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn126:3.4: Āsañ ce pi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ carati, abhabbo phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:3.5: anāsañ ce pi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ carati, abhabbo phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:3.6: āsañ ca anāsañ ce pi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ carati, abhabbo phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:3.7: n' ev' āsaṃ nānāsañ ce pi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ carati, abhabbo phalassa adhigamāyāti.
mn126:3.8: Idha bhoto Bhūmijassa satthā kiṃvādī kimakkhāyī ti?
mn126:4.1: Na kho me taṃ, rājakumāra, Bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ.
mn126:4.2: Ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ Bhagavā evaṃ vyākareyya:--
mn126:4.3: Āsañ ce pi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ carati, abhabbo phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:4.4: anasañ ce pi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ carati, abhabbo phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:4.5: āsañ ca anāsañ ce pi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ carati, abhabbo phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:4.6: n' ev' āsaṃ nānāsañ ce pi karitvā ayoniso brahmacariyaṃ carati, abhabbo phalassa adhigamāya.
mn126:4.7: Āsañ ce pi karitvā yoniso brahmacariyaṃ carati, bhabbo phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:4.8: anāsañ ce pi karitvā yoniso brahmacariyaṃ carati, bhabbo phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:4.9: āsañ ca anāsañ ce pi karitvā yoniso brahmacariyaṃ carati, bhabbo phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:4.10: n' ev' āsaṃ nānāsañ ce pi karitvā yoniso brahmacariyaṃ carati, bhabbo phalassa adhigamāyāti.
mn126:4.11: Na kho me taṃ, rājakumāra, Bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭigghītaṃ,
mn126:4.12: ṭhānañ ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ Bhagavā evaṃ vyākareyyāti.
mn126:5.1: Sace kho bhoto Bhūmijassa satthā evaṃvādī evamakkhāyī, addhā bhoto Bhūmijassa satthā sabbesaṃ yeva puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ muddhānaṃ maññe āhacca tiṭṭhatīti.
mn126:6.1: Atha kho Jayaseno rājakumāro āyasmantaṃ Bhūmijaṃ saken' eva thālipākena parivisi.
mn126:7.1: Atha kho āyasmā Bhūmijo pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Bhūmijo Bhagavantaṃ etad
mn126:7.2: avoca:-Idhāhaṃ, bhante, pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Jayasenassa rājakumārassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃ upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃ.
mn126:7.3: Atha kho, bhante, Jayaseno rājakumāro yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā mama saddhiṃ sammodi
mn126:7.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho, bhante, Jayaseno rājakumāro maṃ etad avoca:
mn126:7.11: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ, bhante, Jayasenaṃ rājakumāraṃ etad avoca:
mn126:7.12: Na kho me taṃ, rājakumāra, Bhagavato sammukhā . . .
mn126:7.25: Kacci, bhante, evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ vyākaramāno vuttavādī c' eva Bhagavato homi, na ca Bhagavantam abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaromi na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti?
mn126:8.1: Taggha tvaṃ, Bhūmija, evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ vyākaramāno vuttavādī c' eva Bhagavato hosi na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhasi dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākarosi na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
mn126:9.1: Ye hi keci, Bhūmija, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā micchāditthino micchāsaṃkappā micchāvācā micchākammantā micchā-ājīvā micchāvāyāmā micchāsatī micchāsamādhino, te āsañ ce pi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:9.2: anāsavañ ce pi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:9.3: āsañ ca anāsañ ce pi . . . adhigamāya;
mn126:9.4: n' ev' āsaṃ nānāsañ ce pi . . . adhigamāya.
mn126:9.6: Ayoni h' esā, Bhūmija, phalassa adhigamāya.
mn126:10.1: Seyyathāpi, Bhūmija, puriso telatthiko telagavesī telapariyesanañ caramāno vālikaṃ doṇiyā ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ pīḷeyya;
mn126:10.2: āsañ ce pi karitvā vālikaṃ doṇiyā ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ pīḷeyya, abhabbo telassa adhigamāya;
mn126:10.3: anāsañ ce karitvā vālikaṃ doṇiyā ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ pīḷeyya, abhabbo telassa adhigamāya;
mn126:10.4: āsañ ca anāsañ ce pi karitvā vālikaṃ doṇiyā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ pīḷeyya, abhabbo telassa adhigamāya;
mn126:10.5: n' ev' āsaṃ nānāsañ ce pi karitvā vālikaṃ doṇiyā ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ pīḷeyya, abhabbo telassa adhigamāya.
mn126:10.7: Ayoni h' esā Bhūmija, telassa, adhigamāya. --
mn126:10.8: Evam eva kho, Bhūmija, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā va micchādiṭṭhī micchāsaṃkappā . . . micchāsamādhino, te āsañ ce pi karitvā brahmacariyaṃ caranti. abhabbā phalassa adhigamāya;
mn126:10.10: āsañ ca anāsañ ce pi . . . adhigamāya;
mn126:10.11: n' ev' āsaṃ nānāsañ ce pi . . . adhigamāya.
mn126:10.13: Ayoni h' esā, Bhūmija, phalassa adhigamāya.

mn126:13.1: Seyyathāpi, Bhūmija, puriso aggitthiko aggigavesī aggipariyesanañ caramāno allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimattheyya,

mn126:18.5: karitvā sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ koḷāpaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimattheyya, bhabbo aggissa adhigamāya; āsañ ca anāsañ ce pi karitvā sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ koḷāpaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimattheyya, bhabbo aggissa adhigamāya; n' ev' āsaṃ nānāsañ ce pi karitvā sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ koḷāpaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimatthāyya, bhabbo aggissa adhigamāya.

mn126:19.1: Sace kho, Bhūmija, Jayasenassa rājakumārassa imā catasso upamā paṭibhāseyyuṃ. anacchariyaṃ te Jayaseno rājakumāro pasīdeyya, pasanno ca te pasannākāraṃ kareyyāti.
mn126:19.2: Kuto pana maṃ, bhante, Jayasenassa rājakumārassa imā catasso upamā paṭibhāsissanti anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā, seyyathāpi Bhagavantan ti.
mn126:19.4: Attamano āyasmā Bhūmijo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 127.
